name: Mary Beth Merragrove
source: Mary Beth is the second roommate of [url=/c166785]Ryder[/url]. She's known him since he was young, even helping to raise him after his mother's passing. The owner of the Mutton Dagger, she is known for her kind heart, but is willing to give you shit if you deserve it. She always puts Ryder and [url=/c166789]Lila[/url] ahead of her own needs and desires.
